headline_item.title_en: Seattle-based StepSecurity, which offers a software supply chain security platform, raised a $20M Series A led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 软件供应链安全初创公司StepSecurity完成2000万美元A轮融资，总融资额达2300万美元
headline_item.event_summary_en: Seattle-based software supply chain security platform StepSecurity has raised $20 million in Series A funding led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23 million. The capital will be utilized to bolster its automated, real-time security solutions for CI/CD pipelines and the software development lifecycle.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】StepSecurity（软件供应链安全初创公司）、Elephant（领投机构）在西雅图（公司总部）：完成2000万美元A轮融资
【起因与机理】应对日益严峻的软件供应链攻击风险，增强CI/CD流水线防御
【关键数据与实测】StepSecurity完成2000万美元A轮融资。
【各方立场与态度】核心聚焦CI/CD流水线与软件开发生命周期的自动化安全防护。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] StepSecurity, Elephant (Seattle, USA): Raised $20 million Series A funding
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rising software supply chain threats and need for CI/CD pipeline protection
[Key Position & Outlook] Focus on automated security for CI/CD pipelines and software lifecycle.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 软件供应链攻击已成为DevSecOps环节的致命漏洞，投资方正从单纯的基建安全转向细分的CI/CD自动化防御领域。此轮融资显示资本市场对“预防性安全配置”而非仅“漏洞扫描”产品的价值认可。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Software supply chain attacks have become critical vulnerabilities in DevSecOps; investors are pivoting from generic security tools to specialized CI/CD automation defense. This funding highlights the market's premium on preventative security configuration over simple reactive vulnerability scanning.

headlines.title_en: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
headlines.event_summary_zh: ChatGPT更新实时听写功能，取消语音录入时长限制，支持实时转录与编辑
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI has officially launched the 'Live Dictation' feature across all ChatGPT platforms (Web, Desktop, iOS, and Android), enabling real-time text transcription as users speak. Additionally, OpenAI has removed the previous 10-minute recording limit for voice dictation to enhance reliability and efficiency in handling long-form audio input.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI（人工智能研究机构）在ChatGPT全平台产品（网页、桌面端、移动端）：上线实时听写功能并取消10分钟录入限制
【起因与机理】降低用户输入门槛，优化语音转录体验，提升长内容交互效率
【关键数据与实测】正式取消10分钟音频录入时长限制。
【各方立场与态度】针对长会议与笔记场景优化，提升交互可靠性。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI: Launched live dictation and removed the 10-minute record limit
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Lowering input friction, optimizing transcription experience, and improving long-form interaction efficiency
[Key Fact Detail] Live dictation deployed across all platforms.
[Key Position & Outlook] Optimized for meetings and notes with improved reliability.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 语音交互是AI从“聊天机器人”向“生产力助手”转型的核心路径，实时转录能力的深化显著降低了多模态交互延迟。此举意在通过降低输入摩擦力，进一步粘合专业领域用户，并为后续的实时多模态深度集成奠定用户习惯。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Voice interaction is the core bridge for AI to evolve from a chatbot to a productivity assistant, with real-time transcription significantly reducing multimodal latency. This move aims to minimize input friction, improve retention for professional users, and build user behavior for future deep-integrated multimodal interactions.

headlines.title_zh: Anthropic IPO引发史上罕见财富增长
headlines.title_en: Anthropic IPO Said to Give Nothing to Most Institutional Buyers
headlines.event_summary_zh: Anthropic上市估值超1.4万亿美元，员工及早期投资者资产大幅跃升，引发旧金山地产等行业连锁反应
headlines.event_summary_en: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has successfully debuted on the Nasdaq. With a share price of $83, the company's valuation exceeds $1.4 trillion, placing it among the ten most valuable firms in the U.S. This IPO has triggered an unprecedented wave of wealth creation, with approximately 400 early employees valued at over $100 million each and seven founders holding stakes worth roughly $20 billion each, expected to significantly impact the San Francisco real estate and philanthropic sectors.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic（人工智能公司）在纳斯达克证券交易所：上市发行价83美元，市值突破1.4万亿美元
【起因与机理】AI算力与模型研发市场爆发，带来史无前例的股权激励兑现
【关键数据与实测】IPO估值超1.4万亿美元，进入美股前十大市值企业。
【行业影响与走向】巨额财富溢出效应将影响旧金山房地产市场与慈善捐赠生态。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic (Nasdaq Stock Market): IPO price $83/share, valuation exceeded $1.4 trillion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Surging AI compute/model market adoption leading to massive equity realization
[Key Metrics] Valuation exceeds $1.4 trillion, ranking among top 10 US companies.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Wealth overflow to impact SF real estate and philanthropic sectors.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: Anthropic的万亿级市值标志着大模型厂商从一级市场溢价走向二级市场定价的里程碑。此次财富效应将直接强化硅谷的高地效应，短期内资本的二次循环（通过房地产与慈善）将导致旧金山资产价格结构性波动，并进一步加剧全球高端人才流向AI原生企业的竞争。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Anthropic’s trillion-dollar valuation marks a milestone for LLM providers transitioning from primary market premiums to secondary market pricing. This wealth effect will solidify Silicon Valley's dominance; secondary capital circulation—via real estate and philanthropy—will structurally disrupt San Francisco asset prices and intensify global competition for top-tier AI talent.

titans.name: OpenAI 官方
titans.role_zh: OpenAI 官方发布与模型前沿
titans.event_context_zh:
何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.event_context_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.

https://t.co/xyGPcCkPCK
